points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 1833年10月21日，阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔出生于瑞典斯德哥尔摩。他的父亲伊曼纽尔·诺贝尔是一位发明家和工程师，家境并不富裕。诺贝尔从小就展现出对化学和技术的浓厚兴趣，但体弱多病，经常因病缺课。这段时期，父亲多次创业失败，家庭经济拮据，这些经历对诺贝尔后来的性格和价值观产生了深远影响，培养了他坚韧不拔的品质和对实用发明的追求。
points.descriptionEn: Born on October 21, 1833, in Stockholm, Sweden, Alfred Nobel came from a family of modest means. His father Immanuel Nobel was an inventor and engineer who experienced several business failures. Despite his poor health, young Nobel showed early interest in chemistry and technology. The family's financial struggles during these years shaped Nobel's character, fostering resilience and a practical approach to invention that would define his later career.

points.title: 化学深造
points.description: 1850年，17岁的诺贝尔前往巴黎深造，在著名化学家佩里奥的实验室学习。这段时期他系统学习了化学知识，并接触到硝化甘油这一爆炸性物质。1859年，因父亲在圣彼得堡的工厂经营困难，诺贝尔返回欧洲协助父亲工作。在巴黎期间，他不仅掌握了先进的化学技术，还结识了许多科学家和工程师，这些关系网络为他后来的发明事业奠定了基础。他对硝化甘油的研究也始于这一时期，为他日后发明安全炸药埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: In 1850, at age 17, Nobel traveled to Paris to study chemistry under renowned chemist Professor Peligot. There he systematically studied chemistry and encountered nitroglycerin, an explosive substance. In 1859, due to his father's factory difficulties in St. Petersburg, Nobel returned to Europe to assist. His time in Paris not only advanced his chemical knowledge but also connected him with scientists and engineers who would later support his work. His research on nitroglycerin during this period laid the foundation for his later invention of dynamite.

points.title: 炸药发明
points.description: 1863年，诺贝尔在德国克鲁姆建立了他的第一个实验室，专注于硝化甘油的安全应用研究。经过多次实验，1867年他发明了以硅藻土吸收硝化甘油的稳定炸药，即安全炸药（dynamite）。这项发明解决了硝化甘油不稳定易爆炸的问题，极大提高了采矿和建筑工程的安全性。诺贝尔在克鲁姆期间还建立了工厂生产这种新型炸药，并获得了多项国际专利。这一时期的成功使诺贝尔积累了大量财富，也确立了他在工业化学领域的地位，为他后来建立跨国企业网络奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1863, Nobel established his first laboratory in Krümmel, Germany, focusing on the safe application of nitroglycerin. After numerous experiments, in 1867 he invented dynamite, a stable explosive created by absorbing nitroglycerin in kieselguhr. This invention solved the instability problem of nitroglycerin, significantly improving safety in mining and construction. During his time in Krümmel, Nobel also established factories to produce this new explosive and obtained multiple international patents. This period of success brought Nobel considerable wealth and established his position in industrial chemistry, laying the foundation for his later multinational enterprise network.

points.title: 商业帝国
points.description: 1873年，诺贝尔将总部迁至巴黎，在此建立了一个庞大的商业帝国。他成立了诺贝尔兄弟石油公司，在俄国和高加索地区开发石油资源；同时扩大了炸药生产网络，在全球建立了多家工厂。诺贝尔在巴黎期间还发明了无烟火药、胶状炸药等多种新型爆炸物，并涉足军工领域。他的企业遍布20多个国家，成为真正的跨国公司。然而，巴黎时期也是诺贝尔个人生活最为复杂的阶段，他终身未婚，但与多位女性保持亲密关系，同时面临着日益增长的财富带来的社会责任问题。这段经历促使他开始思考财富的终极意义，为后来设立诺贝尔奖埋下思想伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: In 1873, Nobel moved his headquarters to Paris, where he built a vast commercial empire. He established the Nobel Brothers Oil Company, developing oil resources in Russia and the Caucasus region, while expanding his dynamite production network with factories worldwide. During his Paris years, Nobel also invented various new explosives like smokeless powder and gelignite, and entered the military sector. His enterprises operated in over 20 countries, becoming truly multinational. However, this period was also complex personally - Nobel never married but maintained intimate relationships with several women, while facing growing questions about the social responsibility that came with his wealth. These experiences prompted him to reflect on the ultimate meaning of wealth, planting the seeds for his later establishment of the Nobel Prizes.

points.title: 晚年遗志
points.description: 1891年，诺贝尔因健康原因移居意大利圣雷莫，在此度过了他生命的最后五年。尽管健康状况恶化，诺贝尔仍保持着活跃的发明活动，并开始系统规划自己的遗产分配。1895年11月27日，他在巴黎的瑞典-挪威俱乐部签署了著名的遗嘱，将其大部分财产用于设立诺贝尔奖，奖励在物理、化学、医学、文学和和平领域做出杰出贡献的人。这一决定震惊了当时的社会，因为诺贝尔本人是军火制造商，却设立了和平奖。1896年12月10日，诺贝尔在圣雷莫逝世，享年63岁。他的遗嘱执行过程中遇到了法律障碍，但最终在1901年首次颁发诺贝尔奖，成为人类历史上最具影响力的科学和文化奖项之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1891, due to declining health, Nobel moved to Sanremo, Italy, where he spent the final five years of his life. Despite his deteriorating health, Nobel remained active in invention and began systematically planning his estate distribution. On November 27, 1895, he signed his famous will at the Swedish-Norwegian Club in Paris, bequeathing most of his fortune to establish the Nobel Prizes for outstanding contributions in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature, and peace. This decision shocked society as Nobel was himself a manufacturer of arms yet established a peace prize. On December 10, 1896, Nobel died in Sanremo at age 63. The execution of his will faced legal obstacles, but the first Nobel Prizes were finally awarded in 1901, becoming one of the most influential scientific and cultural awards in human history.

appraisal.zh: 作为19世纪工业革命时代的发明家与企业家，诺贝尔革新了工业炸药技术，推动了采矿、建筑与交通的进步，又以独特方式把个人财富转化为诺贝尔奖这一全球科学与文化的最高荣誉。然而其财富本源于军火制造，与和平奖的设立构成尖锐反差，其发明亦被用于军事、加剧了军备竞赛；他终身未婚、情感生活屡受非议，评奖标准也常被指带有西方中心色彩。总体而言，他集中体现了技术、资本与伦理之间的复杂张力，其形象亦从军火商逐渐转为和平的象征。
appraisal.en: An inventor-entrepreneur of the Industrial Revolution, Nobel revolutionized industrial explosives, advancing mining, construction and transport, and turned his fortune into the Nobel Prizes, now the highest honors in global science and culture. Yet his wealth came from arms manufacture, a stark contrast to the peace prize he founded; his inventions served military ends and intensified the arms race, his unmarried private life drew criticism, and the prizes are often called Western-centric. He embodies the tension between technology, capital and ethics, his image shifting from arms maker to symbol of peace.

supporter.zh: 诺贝尔是一位具有远见卓识的发明家和企业家，他不仅革新了工业炸药技术，推动了采矿、建筑和交通等领域的进步，更以其独特的遗产分配方式，将个人财富转化为促进人类文明发展的永恒动力。诺贝尔奖的设立体现了超越国界的科学精神和人文关怀，激励着一代又一代科学家和思想家追求真理与和平。诺贝尔的一生展现了技术创新与社会责任相结合的可能性，为现代企业家树立了典范。
supporter.en: Alfred Nobel was a visionary inventor and entrepreneur who not only revolutionized industrial explosive technology, advancing progress in mining, construction, and transportation, but also transformed his personal wealth into an eternal force for human civilization through his unique legacy distribution. The establishment of the Nobel Prizes reflects a spirit of international scientific cooperation and humanistic concern, inspiring generations of scientists and thinkers to pursue truth and peace. Nobel's life demonstrated the possibility of combining technological innovation with social responsibility, setting an example for modern entrepreneurs.

critic.zh: 批评者认为诺贝尔作为军火制造商，其财富建立在死亡和破坏之上，与和平奖的设立形成鲜明讽刺。他的发明虽然提高了采矿效率，但也被用于军事目的，加剧了19世纪末的军备竞赛。诺贝尔的个人生活也备受争议，他终身未婚，与多位女性关系复杂，被批评为情感上的自私者。此外，诺贝尔奖的评选标准有时被认为过于西方中心主义，忽视了非西方世界的贡献，反映了诺贝尔本人时代和阶级的局限性。
critic.en: Critics argue that as a manufacturer of arms, Nobel's wealth was built upon death and destruction, creating a stark contrast with his establishment of a peace prize. His inventions, while improving mining efficiency, were also used for military purposes, exacerbating the arms race of the late 19th century. Nobel's personal life was also controversial - he never married and maintained complex relationships with several women, criticized for emotional selfishness. Additionally, the Nobel Prize selection criteria have sometimes been seen as overly Western-centric, overlooking contributions from non-Western worlds, reflecting Nobel's own era and class limitations.

objective.zh: 从历史客观视角看，诺贝尔是一位典型的19世纪工业革命时期的发明家-企业家，其生平反映了科技、资本与伦理之间的复杂关系。诺贝尔奖已成为全球科学和文化领域的最高荣誉，但其创立过程也揭示了个人财富与社会责任之间的张力。在流行文化中，诺贝尔的形象经历了从军火商到和平使者的转变，成为科技伦理思考的重要象征。他的故事提醒我们，技术创新本身并无善恶，关键在于人类如何运用这些技术，以及如何平衡个人成就与社会贡献。
objective.en: From an historical perspective, Nobel represents a typical inventor-entrepreneur of the Industrial Revolution, reflecting the complex relationship between technology, capital, and ethics. The Nobel Prizes have become the highest honors in global science and culture, but their establishment also reveals the tension between personal wealth and social responsibility. In popular culture, Nobel's image has transformed from arms manufacturer to peace advocate, becoming an important symbol for technological ethics. His story reminds us that technological innovation itself is neither good nor evil - the key lies in how humanity uses these technologies and balances personal achievements with social contributions.

self.zh: 我希望我死后，我的墓碑上只刻上'这里躺着一位发明家，他使人类能够更有效地屠杀自己的同胞'。
self.en: I wish that when I die, my epitaph will read: 'Here lies an inventor who enabled humans to more effectively slaughter their fellow beings.'
